q1_issues.issue: (Instrument sk_return_1 sk_bucket_1) claims the buckets were the means by which the returning was performed; they are carried cargo, which the with-phrase test (CoAgent = animate participant, Instrument = means) does not cover.
(LocatedIn sk_salt_bloom_1 sk_bucket_1) reads containment off an "of"-partitive, though LocatedIn is licensed only for the containment prepositions in / at / inside / within.

q2_gaps: an inanimate accompaniment / cargo "with"-phrase ("returned ... with twelve full buckets") — the with-phrase split offers only CoAgent (animate co-participant) or Instrument (means), neither of which fits
a container/measure partitive ("twelve full buckets of salt-bloom") — excluded from the genitive rules as a measure, but given no positive encoding for the container-contents link or the amount

tense on a prenominal adjectival modifier distributed to a group's members ("twelve full buckets" → (Past (Member $x full)) at statement 14) — the wrapping rule covers copular clauses and appositives, not prenominal modifiers
notes: "The salt-bloom stayed potent" (31-35) follows the continuation-copular pattern exactly, and the "each compartment of the store" universal is a correct per-member rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion and no group event. Both defects come from the same unencodable "twelve full buckets of salt-bloom" phrase.
